{"code": "NOT_FOUND", "message": "Not found"}## Billing

### Payment history

The **Payment history** card on the org

billing page lists your recent credit top-ups. Each row shows:

| Column | Details |
| - | - |
| Date | When the top-up was pr

ocessed |
| Amount | Amount charged in USD |
| Status | `Succeeded`, `Pending`, or `Failed` |
| Receipt | Link to the Stripe-ho
sted receipt (opens in a new tab) |\n\nIf a receipt isn't available yet the cell shows **Processing** (for pending charges) or **N
ot available** (for succeeded charges without a receipt link).\n\nTo add credits, click **Top up**, either from the empty state wh

en you have no history, or from the credit balance card above.

> [!NOTE]
>
> **Free plan organizations cannot purchase credit
s directly.** If your organization is on the Free plan, the Top up dialog shows a message that only an organization owner can upgr
ade the plan, with a **Compare plans** button. Clicking it closes the dialog and opens your organization's Plans settings so you c

an upgrade.

> [!NOTE]
>
> **Desktop app:** When you confirm a top-up in the desktop app, checkout opens in your default syste
m browser and the dialog closes automatically. Your credit balance updates in the app once the purchase completes, so no redirect

back into the app is required.

### Auto-reload

Auto-reload buys credits automatically when your balance runs low. It isn't
w many credits each refill buys, from 500 to 1,000,000.\n* **Minimum balance**: a refill runs when your balance falls below this.\
n* **Maximum monthly spend** (optional): the most auto-reload may spend in a\n month, in US dollars. Leave it blank for no limit.

The monthly limit resets each UTC calendar month. Manual top-ups don't count
toward it, and refunds don't reduce it. Saving c

hanged settings turns
auto-reload off until you authorize the card again; saving alone never charges
you.

### Managing billin
g details\n\nOrganization owners on a paid plan see a **Manage billing** button on the billing page. Clicking it opens the Stripe
portal where you can update payment methods, download invoices, add tax IDs, and review billing details. Only organization owners

can access this portal.

### Seat payment failures

When someone you invited to a paid-seat organization signs up and the auto
matic seat charge fails or is cancelled, the org billing page shows a **Seat payment didn't go through** notice. As the org owner

you can:

* Click **Retry payment** to reopen the charge and complete payment (including any 3DS challenge).
* Click **Remove i
nvite** to remove the invite entirely if you no longer want to add that person.\n\nThe invited member's organization appears greye

d out in their sidebar until the seat is paid.
